page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-320 is an Arm-based virtual machine configured for scalable general-purpose compute and parallel execution. Powered by an 80-core Ampere Altra processor using the Neoverse-N1 architecture at a fixed 3.0 GHz clock speed, it allocates 80 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core. The system integrates 320.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio at 4.0 GB per core. It operates without dedicated local NVMe storage, relying on external network block storage for persistence, and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address without bundled hardware accelerators.

Benchmark data indicates pronounced multi-threaded execution capacity, placing stress-ng multi-core performance in the top ten percent at 142440.01. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 394.6 GB/sec, and caching workloads demonstrate high throughput with Redis SET operations achieving 96.98 million operations per second alongside 86.41 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Cached memory bandwidth delivers 5658.98 GB/sec on small 16 KB blocks. Conversely, single-threaded metrics reflect the lower baseline frequency of the architecture, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the middle 50 percent, and single-threaded gzip and bzip3 decompression registering lower results. Uncached memory read bandwidth settles at 183.41 GB/sec, while uncached write bandwidth reaches 78.52 GB/sec.

In terms of resource density, the dedicated non-hyperthreaded core layout prevents resource contention across neighbor threads, offering predictable core-per-dollar efficiency for highly parallelized services. The absence of integrated local storage shifts I/O dependency to network-attached block volumes, while LLM inference speeds range from average for prompt processing to poor for small model generation, showing that large-scale AI generation remains limited without dedicated GPUs. This server profile fits scale-out microservices, highly concurrent web servers, container clusters, Redis caching layers, and multi-threaded data transformation jobs.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A1.Flex.80-320 is a general-purpose compute instance equipped with 80 dedicated physical Ampere Altra Neoverse-N1 arm64 cores operating at 3.0 GHz and 320.0 GB of memory. Designed with a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core, this instance avoids simultaneous multithreading overhead to provide predictable multi-core throughput. Benchmark testing places its multi-core CPU capacity in the top 10 percent, complemented by high-tier performance in multi-threaded decompression, Redis operations exceeding 96 million ops/sec, and static web serving reaching 86.41 GB/sec. Because local disk storage and GPU hardware are absent, the server relies on external storage volumes and is optimized for compute-heavy parallel tasks rather than hardware-accelerated machine learning. It delivers high resource efficiency for horizontally scaled environments, container orchestration, web servers, and parallelized backend processing pipelines.
